card: Fixes an intermittent race condition in the p2p_eviction.py functional test by ensuring Python waits for the peer socket to actually close. This addresses test flakiness tracked in issue #36533 without modifying node behavior. There are no external dependencies.
evidence: Author description: "Fixes https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/issues/36533 by waiting for the socket to actually close on the Python side."
problem: The `p2p_eviction.py` functional test intermittently fails due to a race condition where the test does not wait for a disconnected peer socket to completely close on the Python side before executing subsequent assertions.

risk.why: It only modifies a functional test script, so a flaw could at worst cause the test to fail or hang in CI.

summary: Fixes an intermittent test failure in `p2p_eviction.py` by waiting for the socket connection to close on the Python test framework side before proceeding.
uncertainties: Diff and linked issue body #36533 were not provided in the prompt.
